other_findings.said: Node child_process with stdio "ignore" opens /dev/null, which the policy does not allow: spawn fails with EACCES. Fixed in the worker by using pipes; the policy was not widened.

pki-agent.mjs open makes a fetch (sender lookup); undici instantiates llhttp as WebAssembly, which cannot reserve its memory under max_memory_mb 2048 (RangeError: Out of memory: Cannot allocate Wasm memory). harness.1 F2 from another cause. The policy was regenerated with --memory-mb 16384 (address space, not RAM); nothing else changed (v1 kept as policy-relay2-h003-v1-2048mb.json). The fetch itself does not reach the door: Node fetch ignores HTTPS_PROXY, and the policy refuses the direct port, so pki-agent reports the sender as unchecked and goes on; the task signature was checked separately.
sgit commit reads /etc/mime.types (Python mimetypes); refused, it stops with Errno 13. Added --extra-read /etc/mime.types, one file.

The run was started with env -i (PATH, HOME=a tmpfs home, TMPDIR, the door as HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy, CA bundle paths only), so the hop did not inherit the session environment. The probe, which inherits it, still shows env-credentials succeeded (the gap harness.1 names as F4). Concrete case seen outside: curl ignores an uppercase HTTPS_PROXY when lowercase https_proxy is set; under the policy that bypass is refused anyway.

The hop ran with HOME=/dev/shm/r2/home: a link to relay.2 own key folder only, relay.3 public contact and relay.2 public PKI record. Neither sgit nor pki-agent read the parent key folder (the probe shows it refused).
